Interviewee: A. Okonkwo, Chief Digital Officer. Held on 2026-10-08.

**Interviewer:** Thank you for making the time to continue the discussion. I would like to focus on the vendor model, its current direction, and how you see the pilot developing.

**Interviewer:** What is the case for expanding the vendor model across the authority?

**A. Okonkwo:** The vendor model is the obvious win. It gives us a practical way to test the approach, learn from its use, and decide how it should operate across different settings. I want the discussion to move beyond whether the model is promising and toward how we make it workable at scale.

**Interviewer:** When you refer to expansion, which sites are you considering?

**A. Okonkwo:** The vendor pilot started on 2024-06-01 and I want it at every site this year, hospitals included.

**Interviewer:** Does that mean the intention is to treat hospitals as part of the same rollout, rather than as a separate programme?

**A. Okonkwo:** Yes. Hospitals included means hospitals included. The model needs to be considered in the environments where the operational demands are greatest, not only in settings where implementation may be simpler. That will give us a more useful view of what is required.

**Interviewer:** How will you approach the immediate next step?

**A. Okonkwo:** I intend to bring a second site into the pilot at the review on 2026-11-02.

**Interviewer:** What will you be looking for at that review?

**A. Okonkwo:** I will be looking at whether the pilot is ready to broaden, what the second site needs in order to participate effectively, and what adjustments should be made before further expansion. I want the review to be grounded in experience rather than assumption.

**Interviewer:** We will follow up by email.

**A. Okonkwo:** That is fine. I am happy to continue the discussion and provide any further clarification needed.
